PROJECT NOTES项目说明

Course exercise prompts and datasets retain their original provenance. External datasets are not republished.保留课程题目与数据的原始来源属性，不重新分发外部数据集。

01 / THE QUESTION问题

What needed to work?需要解决什么？

Understand how optimization, feature scaling, model capacity and regularization affect a classifier.理解优化方法、特征缩放、模型容量与正则化如何影响分类器。

02 / THE PROCESS方法

How it comes together.如何将它实现。

  1. Implement logistic regression and regularized polynomial classification, then inspect the loss and decision boundaries.实现逻辑回归与正则化多项式分类，观察损失与决策边界。
  2. Build dense and convolutional MNIST models in Keras, with validation splits and optimizer comparisons.使用 Keras 搭建全连接和卷积 MNIST 模型，设置验证集并比较优化器。

03 / THE OUTCOME成果

What the work shows.项目所呈现的结果。

The original course notebooks have been prepared for public reading with execution outputs cleared and local paths made portable. They are educational exercises, not independent research claims.原课程 Notebook 经输出清理与路径整理后用于公开阅读。这些是教学实验，不作为独立科研成果声称。
